'''Jarnell Stokes''' (born January 7, 1994) is an American [[basketball]] player who recently completed his college career at the [[University of Tennessee]]. He was one of the top rated high school players in the class of 2012.

==High school career==
Stokes is rated as the number 18 player in the class of 2012 in the [[ESPNU]] 100<ref>{{cite web|url=http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/recruiting/rankings |title=2012 College Basketball Recruiting Rankings - ESPNU 100 |publisher=espn.go.com |date= |accessdate=2011-12-03}}</ref> the number 11 player by [[Scout.com]],<ref>{{cite web|url=http://scouthoops.scout.com/a.z?s=75&p=9&c=4&cfg=bb&pid=88&yr=2012 |title=Scout.com College Basketball Team Recruiting Prospects |publisher=Scouthoops.scout.com |date= |accessdate=2011-12-03}}</ref> and the number 11 player by [[Rivals.com]].<ref name=rivals>{{cite web|url=http://rivals.yahoo.com/ncaa/basketball/recruiting/rankings/rank-2509;_ylt=AiI6gfIcQUepfUTytuUWMB3WO5B4 |title=The Rivals150 2012 Prospect Rankings |publisher=Rivalshoops.rivals.com |date= |accessdate=2011-12-03}}</ref> 

Stokes had a long list of college offers including Arkansas, Connecticut, Florida, Kentucky, Memphis, and Tennessee, among others.

Jarnell Stokes selected the University of Tennessee December 22, 2011 on a Thursday night at his favorite local restaurant.  In front of a packed house of friends and media. Stokes made his selection by unwrapping a box with a UT hat inside.  He was joined at a table with his father Willie, mother Shaunte, sister Kylia, and brother Isiah. 

This is the first time in over a decade that a highly recruited talent like Stokes selected to go to the University of Tennessee and leave his home town of Memphis.  He was also Coach Martin's first five star recruit. He said he felt blessed to have this young man select the University of Tennessee and to have the chance to coach such a gifted player.
Stokes enrolled and his first day in Knoxville was his birthday Jan.7 2012 (he turned 18). With only three college practices he played top ranked Kentucky and finished the game with 9 points and 5 Rebounds.  He later had a season high of 16 points against top 25 ranked Connecticut. 

==2014 NBA draft==
On April 12, 2014, Stokes announced that he would forgo his senior year at Tennessee and enter the [[2014 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.cbssports.com/collegebasketball/eye-on-college-basketball/24521687/tennessee-junior-jarnell-stokes-to-announce-hes-entering-nba-draft |title=Tennessee junior Jarnell Stokes to announce he's entering NBA Draft |first=Gary |last=Parrish |publisher=''CBSSports'' |date=April 10, 2014 |accessdate=April 14, 2014}}</ref>
